File Upload

File Upload components allow users to upload files via a standard input or a drag-and-drop zone with preview and progress support.

Basic File Input

Standard file input with ZAKUIKit styling.

HTML
<input type="file" class="zak-input zak-file-input">

Drag and Drop Zone

A clickable and droppable zone for file uploads.

Drag and drop files here, or click to browse

PNG, JPG, PDF up to 10MB
HTML
<div class="zak-file-upload-dropzone" id="dropzone">
  <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-lg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
    <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
    <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="3" y2="15"/>
  </svg>
  <p>Drag and drop files here, or <strong>click to browse</strong></p>
  <span class="zak-form-text">PNG, JPG, PDF up to 10MB</span>
  <input type="file" multiple accept=".png,.jpg,.jpeg,.pdf" style="display:none;">
</div>

File Preview

Display uploaded file information after selection.

HTML + JS
<input type="file" class="zak-input zak-file-input" accept="image/*"
  onchange="showPreview(this, 'preview-area')">
<div id="preview-area" class="zak-file-preview"></div>

Accept Types

Restrict file types using the accept attribute.

HTML
<input type="file" class="zak-input zak-file-input" accept="image/*">
<input type="file" class="zak-input zak-file-input" accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt">
<input type="file" class="zak-input zak-file-input" multiple>

Upload Progress

Show upload progress using a progress bar.

72% uploaded
Upload complete
HTML
<div class="zak-progress" style="height: 8px;">
  <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-bg-primary" style="width: 72%;" role="progressbar"
    aria-valuenow="72" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"></div>
</div>
<span class="zak-form-text">72% uploaded</span>

JS Drag-and-Drop Demo

Interactive drag-and-drop with click fallback.

JavaScript
const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone');
const fileInput = dropzone.querySelector('input[type="file"]');

dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());

dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  dropzone.classList.add('zak-file-upload-dropzone-active');
});

dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
  dropzone.classList.remove('zak-file-upload-dropzone-active');
});

dropzone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  dropzone.classList.remove('zak-file-upload-dropzone-active');
  const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
  fileInput.files = files;
  console.log('Files dropped:', files);
});

function showPreview(input, areaId) {
  const area = document.getElementById(areaId);
  area.innerHTML = '';
  Array.from(input.files).forEach(file => {
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'zak-file-preview-item';
    item.textContent = file.name + ' (' + (file.size / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB)';
    area.appendChild(item);
  });
}

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-file-inputStyled file input
.zak-file-upload-dropzoneDrag-and-drop zone
.zak-file-upload-dropzone-activeActive drag state
.zak-file-upload-textDropzone text
.zak-file-previewFile preview container
.zak-file-preview-itemIndividual preview item

Accessibility

  • Always use a visible <label> for file inputs.
  • Ensure dropzone is keyboard accessible — support Enter and Space to trigger the file dialog.
  • Add aria-label to the dropzone if no visible label exists.
  • Announce upload status changes with aria-live regions.
  • Provide text alternatives for icon-only upload zones.
